title: Surfaces of general type with extremal cotangent dimension
summary: We study the geography of surfaces of general type with extremal cotangent dimension, in other words surfaces which have either no global holomorphic symmetric differentials at all or the maximal asymptotic growth of their number, i.e. big cotangent bundle. We are mainly interested in surfaces with low slope K^2 /$χ$, which, as far as maximal cotangent dimension is concerned, were out of reach of previous methods.
